notes.title: Version 1.065
notes.content:
[h1]🔧 Update 1.065 – New Version Now Live! 🔧[/h1]

[u]Shinobi, version 1.065 is here and it brings a brand-new Invite System to the game! 🎉[/u]

[h3]👥 Invite Your Friends[/h3]
Now, when your friend registers, they can enter your username as their referrer.
Once they make their first purchase of 500 credits or more, you’ll receive a Friendship Kunai!

[h3]💠 Use Friendship Kunai to unlock:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Amazing exclusive items
[*]Clan Chests
[*]Silver Magatama
[*]More Amazing items
[/list]

[h3]🧍 Feeling solo? [/h3]
No problem. You can also buy Friendship Kunai for 1000 credits each.
Start inviting and start earning – your rewards await! 🔥

notes.title: Version 1.064
notes.content:
Version 1.064 (Bug Fixes)
Fixed damage reduction items - they were bugged on version 1.063
Fixed flat bleeding skills- was also bugged on version 1.063
Fixed issue where effect that applied on certain turn only applies after the opponent got his turn (now it will apply on next turn even if its yours) - making bleeding effect more lethal

notes.title: Version 1.063
notes.content:
Version 1.063 is now available including brand new updates!
- New PVP Leagues
- Option to mark items as favorites and view them only
- New Secret Talents (more coming soon)
- Option to buy Ninjutsu & Kenjutsu from Academy (skills coming soon)
- Option to upgrade Ninjutsu & Kenjutsu in the advanced academy (skills coming soon)

notes.title: Version 1.060
notes.content:
🛠️ Update Now Live – The Most Awaited Version Has Arrived! 🛠️

The wait is over, shinobi! Our latest and most anticipated update is finally here! 🔥

🌟 What’s New:
⚔️ Two new primary talents: Clay & Shadows
🗡️ Introducing a brand-new jutsu type: Kenjutsu (Sword Jutsu)
⚙️ Tons of battle system improvements (to be revealed over the coming weeks!)
🎨 New UI touch: Hover over a jutsu to see its elemental affinity

This update sets the stage for some big things ahead—dive in and start experimenting with the new powers! 💥

notes.title: Version 1.049 - Senjutsu Release!
notes.content:
[h2]Have you completed the Kage Exam and wondered, what's new?[/h2]

Senjutsu is now available in the bloodline shop / talent inventory!
Buy your favorite senjutsu, upgrade and equip your favorite skills!

[i]Note: Currently only 3 senjutsus available and 3 skills of each senjutsu, however, MORE are coming![/i]

Make sure to visit the blacksmith and the pet shop because they contain new items!

notes.title: Version 1.046
notes.content:
[i]* This version includes additional performance improvements.[/i]

[h2]Player Stats Feature[/h2]
In addition, introducing the new player stats feature.
Click the question mark below the character to view his item stats (backitem / weapon) and view all of the effects the character is currently under.
This feature is created to help new players who are not familiar with the items the game has, and attempts to help players who are not focused during matches.

notes.title: Version 1.042
notes.content:
[h1]Version 1.042 is now available![/h1]
Introducing Few New Updates:
[olist]
[*] Alliance System
[*] Flying Thunder God Talent
[*] Ninjutsu Skills
[*] New Tutorial
[/olist]

Alliance System - Alliance System allows you to form an alliance with your friend, and compete against other alliances in village conquest.
Remember, by the end of the season the owner of the villages gain their rewards!

Flying Thunder God Talent - Available for premium users at 10k gems but offers brand new jutsus, in addition, it may offer its own class soon!

Ninjustu - Some skills are aligned as genjutsu but arent really genjutsu, for example, summoning.
Now you will be able to have a new label for them which will block it from being rebounded by Darkness Users.

Tutorial - Get to know the game more when playing the game for the first time.

notes.title: Two Year Anniversary Celebration
notes.content:
[h1]Happy 2-year anniversary to Shinobi Warfare's Official Lunch![/h1]
We are so happy and thankful for these two years. From the exciting exams, big clan wars, arena battles and every  mission you've joined has made our game special. A big thank you to all our players - you are the reason we keep going.
As we celebrate today, we're also excited about new adventures, like the Alliance, that we'll share soon.
Here's to more fun times and victories together. 
Thank you for being a part of Shinobi Warfare. 
Let's look forward to many more years of fun and friendship. 🌟🎊

We'd also like to share a redeem code to all of our players containing 1000 gems (Limited to first 10K claimers).

Use redeem code: 2NDANNIVERSARY in the Redeem House.

New Features:

notes.title: Version 1.029
notes.content:
Version 1.029 is now available, featuring the new Classes which can be acquired inside the Bloodline Shop and requires the users to become Anbu Ranked Shinobis.
Classes can be used no matter what condition the character is in, even if it is locked - however, it can only be used once.
Standard classes with green background can be acquired first time for free, however, changing them would require 1000 gems, on the other hand, the unique ones with the black background would require the user to pre-own a certain talent and would cost gems even though its the users first time acquiring a class, so pay attention!
Note: Scratch card is back and new event is coming!!!!

notes.title: Version 1.026
notes.content:
Version 1,026 is finally out followed with additional UI improvements, this time in Clan Wars!
Introducing the brand new clan war system where manual is far more valuable than quick attacks!
Want to gain more reputation?
Fighting against one player will grant double reputation, two players triple reputation while three players will grant quadruple reputation!!!
In addition, lets say hello to the brand new Magnetic Sand talent which is now available in the bloodline shop as a primary talent which can be bought for 1 Million gold only (but requires premium).
And finally, new talent skill levels are in the horizon so prepare your talent points!

notes.title: Version 1.020
notes.content:
[b]Version 1.020[/b]
[i]After a long waiting we are glad to introduce the new Shinobi Pass!
How does it work?[/i]

Complete your daily tasks to exchange for Shinobi Points and additional rewards, and exchange it for your shinobi pass road rewards!

Task Span Rate:
- Every 24 hours, new tasks will be spawned (daily tasks)
- Every 7 days, new tasks will be spawned (weekly tasks) - Available after April 5th.
- Once in a lifetime tasks, will be spawned only once and available until the end - Available after April 20th.

Need more help and assistance? 
Check us out on discord!
[url=discord.gg/shinobiwarfare]Discord Link[/url]
